decision_needed.question: Payments in lieu of taxes to the City of Hastings are printed as a nonoperating expense (the MD&A calls them transfers to the City's general fund). FY2023 records them as spending (as printed, Other Taxes Paid), while the FY2025 file records them as business-type transfers out. Which treatment should both years use?

notes: Entirely business-type (Hastings Utilities: Electric Fund and Combined System = gas, water, pollution control, administration). Statement lines from the Total 2023 column (p6; Electric/Combined and 2022 columns ignored). No single receipts/disbursements totals printed, so reported_totals are sums of printed lines (computed). Allocated administration interest and other revenue 804,466 split using the Administration statement's own other income lines (p17: interest income 644,729 + miscellaneous income 159,737). Loss on disposal (442,187) kept as a negative nonoperating line (Loss on Disposal of Assets, user 2026-11-06); contributions in aid of construction 240,739 in business_type.other_financing; payments in lieu of taxes kept as printed (nonoperating expense; see decision_needed). Roll: 237,648,343 + 90,194,792 - 86,990,993 + 240,739 = 241,092,881. Balance sheet: Total 2023 column (p4); interfund receivable (payable) nets to '-' in the Total column (Electric (15,682,765) / Combined +15,682,765), so no line; restricted for debt service '-'. Accrued interest payable printed (880). Detail: departmental statements for Electric (p11), Gas (p14), Water (p15) and Pollution Control (p16); detail_totals are the printed operating revenue/expense totals and the nonoperating lines are marked outside_printed_total. The Combined System departmental summary (p12-13) repeats p14-16 and the Administration statement (p17) is fully allocated to the departments (change in net position 0), so neither is recorded separately. Pages 1-2 are MD&A (charts and narrative). No schedules appear cut off by the trim. Read pages 1-17 of 17
